title: S373P Mutation Stabilizes the Receptor-binding Domain of Spike Protein in Omicron and Promotes Binding
authors: Bin Zheng; Yuelong Xiao; Bei Tong; Yutong Mao; Rui Ge; Fang Tian; Xianchi Dong; Peng Zheng
one_liner_zh: 该文通过AFM单分子力谱和MD模拟研究Omicron刺突蛋白RBD的S373P突变对机械稳定性和ACE2结合的影响，虽涉及蛋白-蛋白互作和MD方法，但对象为病毒蛋白与受体，非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，与TF-DNA课题关联较弱。
abstract: A cluster of several newly occurring mutations on Omicron are found at the β-core region of spike protein’s receptor-binding domain (RBD), where mutation rarely happened before. Notably, the binding of SARS-CoV-2 to human receptor ACE2 via RBD happens in a dynamic airway environment, where mechanical force caused by coughing or sneezing occurs and applies to the proteins. Thus, we used atomic force microscopy-based single-molecule force spectroscopy (AFM-SMFS) to measure the stability of RBDs and found that the mechanical stability of Omicron RBD increased by ~20% compared with the wild-type. Molecular dynamics simulations revealed that Omicron RBD showed more hydrogen bonds in the β-core region due to the closing of the α-helical motif caused primarily by mutation S373P, which was further confirmed experimentally. Moreover, the binding ability of Omicron to ACE2 is promoted with a stabilized RBD. This work reveals the effect of the highly conserved mutation S373P which is present in most Omicron subvariants, including BA.1-5, BQ. 1, XBB, and CH.1.1.
abstract_zh: 在Omicron上发现的一簇新发突变位于刺突蛋白受体结合域（RBD）的β-核心区域，该区域此前很少发生突变。值得注意的是，SARS-CoV-2通过RBD与人类受体ACE2的结合发生在动态的气道环境中，在此环境中，咳嗽或打喷嚏引起的机械力作用于蛋白质。因此，我们使用基于原子力显微镜的单分子力谱（AFM-SMFS）测量RBD的稳定性，发现Omicron RBD的机械稳定性相比野生型增加了约20%。分子动力学模拟揭示，Omicron RBD在β-核心区域显示出更多的氢键，这主要是由于突变S373P引起的α-螺旋基序闭合所致，该结果进一步通过实验得到证实。此外，Omicron与ACE2的结合能力在RBD稳定化后得到增强。这项工作揭示了高度保守突变S373P的作用，该突变存在于大多数Omicron亚变体中，包括BA.1-5、BQ.1、XBB和CH.1.1。
